```lean
import Mathlib

/-- What is the value of `x` if `x = (2009 ^ 2 - 2009) / 2009`? Show that it is `2008`. -/
theorem p02_frac_cancel (x : ℝ) (h : x = (2009 ^ 2 - 2009) / 2009) : x = 2008 := by
  have h0 : (2009 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by norm_num
  have hx : x = (2009 : ℝ) - 1 := by
    calc
      x = (2009 ^ 2 - 2009) / 2009 := h
      _ = ((2009 : ℝ) * (2009 - 1)) / 2009 := by ring
      _ = ((2009 : ℝ) / 2009) * (2009 - 1) := by
        field_simp [h0]
      _ = (1 : ℝ) * (2009 - 1) := by
        field_simp [h0]
      _ = (2009 : ℝ) - 1 := by ring
  calc
    x = (2009 : ℝ) - 1 := hx
    _ = 2008 := by norm_num
```
